response.original_title: Animated Classics Collection: The Wind in the Willows
response.overview: Mole leaves his home to witness spring for the first time and meets Rat who takes him boating. The two run into the automobile-obsessed Toad, leading to an adventure into the dreaded Wildwood, breaking toad out of prison, and ridding Toad Hall of weasels.
